title: ECMWF puts AI forecasts (AIFS) into operation
summary: The European center operationalized AIFS Single on February 25, 2025, alongside the physical IFS model. ECMWF reports gains of up to 20% on tropical-cyclone tracks and about 1,000 times lower energy use. It is deterministic, at 28 km versus 9 km for IFS.

evidence.unknown: The page does not describe the verification methods or datasets, the grid is 28 km versus 9 km for IFS, and ensemble forecasting is a future step.
evidence.ai_role: A machine learning model trained on past weather evolution projects the same initial conditions as the IFS model forward every six hours.
